fact: NBC reports Namibia's Ministry of Home Affairs launched online applications, payment and SMS tracking for passports and short-term work visas at eservices.mhaiss.gov.na.
New Era says that only 13 public institutions currently offer online services, and NDP6 targets 100% digitalisation of government services by 2029/30.

Prime Minister Saara Kuugongelwa-Amadhila told Parliament she had launched an online death-registration service under Home Affairs, and listed eleven other implemented online systems including online visa and permits, business registration and deeds registration, at various stages of implementation.
